title: Bring It Over: The Food Counter's Own Word
label: ch:mw-bring-request
canDo: I can order any of the seven food words this book has taught, and tell the five asking words apart by the job each one does.

payoff.summary: The asking word a food counter needs arrives by ear, joins a food noun in the shortest complete sentence this track writes, and the five asking words taught so far are then separated by job in four separately scored skills.
